name.text: Secant-tangent theorem - find the tangent length PT (INNODEMS)

questiontext.text:
From an external point \(P\), a secant and a tangent are drawn to a circle. The secant meets the circle at \(A\) and \(B\), with \( PA = {@PA@} \) cm and \( AB = {@AB@} \) cm. The tangent touches the circle at \(T\). Find the length of the tangent \(PT\).

[[jsxgraph width="480px" height="430px"]] var PA = {#PA#}, PB = {#PB#}, PT = {#ta_pt#}; var rad = Math.PI / 180; var u = [Math.cos(150 * rad), Math.sin(150 * rad)]; var w = [Math.cos(212 * rad), Math.sin(212 * rad)]; var Pp = [0, 0]; var Ap = [PA * u[0], PA * u[1]], Bp = [PB * u[0], PB * u[1]]; var Tp = [PT * w[0], PT * w[1]]; function circum(p1, p2, p3) { var x1 = p1[0], y1 = p1[1], x2 = p2[0], y2 = p2[1], x3 = p3[0], y3 = p3[1]; var d = 2 * (x1 * (y2 - y3) + x2 * (y3 - y1) + x3 * (y1 - y2)); var cx = ((x1*x1 + y1*y1) * (y2 - y3) + (x2*x2 + y2*y2) * (y3 - y1) + (x3*x3 + y3*y3) * (y1 - y2)) / d; var cy = ((x1*x1 + y1*y1) * (x3 - x2) + (x2*x2 + y2*y2) * (x1 - x3) + (x3*x3 + y3*y3) * (x2 - x1)) / d; return [cx, cy]; } var ctr = circum(Ap, Bp, Tp); var rr = Math.hypot(ctr[0] - Ap[0], ctr[1] - Ap[1]); var pad = 1.2; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [ctr[0] - rr - pad, ctr[1] + rr + pad, Math.max(ctr[0] + rr, 0) + pad + 0.6, ctr[1] - rr - pad], keepaspectratio: true, axis: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false }); board.create('circle', [ctr, rr], {strokeColor: '#178a8a', strokeWidth: 1.5, fixed: true}); board.create('segment', [Pp, Bp], {strokeColor: '#333', strokeWidth: 1.5, fixed: true}); board.create('segment', [Pp, Tp], {strokeColor: '#333', strokeWidth: 1.5, fixed: true}); var A = board.create('point', Ap, {name: 'A', size: 2, fixed: true, fillColor: '#333', strokeColor: '#333', label: {offset: [2, 12], anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'bottom'}}); var B = board.create('point', Bp, {name: 'B', size: 2, fixed: true, fillColor: '#333', strokeColor: '#333', label: {offset: [-4, 12], anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'bottom'}}); var T = board.create('point', Tp, {name: 'T', size: 2, fixed: true, fillColor: '#333', strokeColor: '#333', label: {offset: [-4, -12], anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'top'}}); var P = board.create('point', Pp, {name: 'P', size: 2, fixed: true, fillColor: '#333', strokeColor: '#333', label: {offset: [10, 0], anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle'}}); function lbl(p1, p2, dy, txt) { board.create('text', [(p1[0] + p2[0]) / 2, (p1[1] + p2[1]) / 2 + dy, txt], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 13, fixed: true, cssStyle: 'color:#333'}); } lbl(Pp, Ap, 0.8, PA + ' cm'); lbl(Ap, Bp, 0.8, PB - PA + ' cm'); lbl(Pp, Tp, -0.8, '? cm'); [[/jsxgraph]]
\( PT = \) [[input:ans1]]\(\text{ cm}\) [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
First find the whole distance along the secant from \(P\):

\[ PB = PA + AB = {@PA@} + {@AB@} = {@PB@}\text{ cm}. \]

By the secant-tangent theorem, the tangent length satisfies \( PT^2 = PA\cdot PB \), so

\[ PT^2 = {@PA@}\times{@PB@} = {@PA*PB@} \quad\Rightarrow\quad PT = \sqrt{{@PA*PB@}} = {@ta_pt@}\text{ cm}. \]

node.description: Gave PT^2 = PA*PB (forgot the square root).

truefeedback.text: You have found \(PT^2 = PA\cdot PB\). The tangent length \(PT\) is the square root of that. Take the square root and try again.

node.description: Used AB instead of PB and forgot the square root (gave PA*AB).

truefeedback.text: It looks like you worked out \(PA\times AB\). Two things to fix: use \(PB = PA + AB\) (the whole secant length) rather than the chord \(AB\); and \(PT\) is the square root of \(PA\cdot PB\). Try again.

node.description: Took the square root but used the chord AB instead of PB.

truefeedback.text: You have taken a square root correctly, but used the chord \(AB\) instead of the whole secant \(PB\). The theorem is \(PT^2 = PA\cdot PB\) with \(PB = PA + AB\). Try again.

falsefeedback.text: Use the secant-tangent theorem \(PT^2 = PA\cdot PB\), remembering that \(PB = PA + AB\). Then take the square root to find \(PT\). Have another go.
